name: cli-session-routing
body: The session routing surface: the durable `apg node` / `apg edge` commands and `apg query` as the callers that route through a live session. `rust.apg.node_cmd.cmd_node` and `rust.apg.node_cmd.cmd_edge` send a mutation to the session and print the reply; `rust.apg.query.cmd_query` routes a read through the session when one is live and opens the database directly otherwise.
